label: End-of-episode D2 after choosing a2 and reaching S2 following a rewarded trial (low value)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), only when this trial chose a2 (100%), and almost only in the last ~10 trials of an episode (ep_trial 90-99 holds 99.8% of mass; all activations sit in the lowest value bin, value < 5.22, which is the end-of-episode value drop). About 96% of mass is on D2 steps where S2 was reached (common a2->S2), and 94% follows a rewarded previous trial. Mostly in episodes where S2 is currently good (late-episode streaks of a2). Magnitude builds over a run of consecutive rewarded a2->S2 trials (e.g. 0.4 -> 0.9 -> 1.0 across successive trials). It is weaker (~0.1-0.3) on rare a2->S1 D2 steps and after an unrewarded trial. It never fires at D1/GO, after a1, or before trial ~88. Every variable is observable at D2 (action and state are shown, value is the model own output). Dev: P 0.69 R 0.78 F1 0.73, mass recall 0.90. Using ep_trial>=91 in place of value gives F1 0.63. Precision is incomplete: many late a2->S2 D2 steps stay silent, mostly early in a streak or after an unrewarded trial.
